newsitem.title: CHINA: Ex-Beijing boss faces dereliction of duty.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Beijing boss faces dereliction of duty.

text.p: Beijing's disgraced Communist Party boss Chen Xitong could be punished for dereliction of duty, but investigations have turned up no more serious wrongdoings, Beijing Vice-Mayor Zhang Baifa said on Monday.
"Viewing the situation from the case of (former Beijing vice mayor) Wang Baosen, he can't escape dereliction of duty," Zhang told reporters at a reception in Beijing.

However, he said that investigations since Chen was sacked as Beijing party boss in April 1995 had shown no evidence of more serious wrongdoing although it had been established that Chen had accepted expensive gifts.
Chen was sacked after vice mayor Wang committed suicide after coming under investigation in a corruption scandal involving more than $37 million.
The former Beijing party chief and Politburo member has not been seen in public since his disgrace.
